lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Republican Mike Rogers and Democrat Abdul El-Sayed talk about their platforms, how they’d represent Michigan as senators in Washington and what it would mean if they win in the midterm election, CBS News reports.

Israeli police on Sunday released two of three suspects in a case of alleged voter bribery, weakening efforts by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud party to discredit last week’s parliamentary elections, The Associated Press reports.

Civilians in Ukraine’s southeastern Kherson region prepared Sunday for the end of a localized ceasefire that has marked the most significant truce between Kyiv and Moscow since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine began nearly five years ago, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
